meaning: Cleaning motor error: LG says LE may appear when the cleaning motor is not functioning normally.
causes: An issue with the cleaning motor, the cause LG gives
diySteps: LG gives no homeowner fix for LE: it says the error requires inspection by a service technician
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: LG says an LE error requires inspection from a service technician. Not the same as nE, which LG uses when the impeller does not spin or dishes touch it; nE has a rearrange-and-restart step first. Not the same as LG washer LE either, which is a washer motor error (the tub failed to spin) with its own steps.
sourceTitle: [LG Dishwasher] Guide to Error Codes (LG USA Support)
